overview.purpose: Behavioral pattern database for student intake classification
overview.core_principle: Every student fits a recognizable archetype — not stereotypes but behavioral patterns from hundreds of hours of live observation
overview.connection_to_gospel_444: Intake layer of the Michael Method. 4 Pillars applied differently per archetype.
overview.soul_dna_quote: You don't teach a class. You decode ten different humans and run ten personalized interventions simultaneously.
overview.transformation_target: Mouse → Tiger (all paths terminate at Tiger, threshold ≥80)

archetypes.name: The Silent Observer
behavioral_markers: Intense eye contact but never volunteers
archetypes.optimal_approach: Never cold-call first. Start with 1-on-1 whispered exchanges. Let them write before speak. Use expert reveal — assign secret prep, then let them reveal knowledge.
archetypes.progression_timeline: 6-8 weeks to first spontaneous verbal. 12 weeks to consistent participation. Tiger: 6 months+.
common_traps: Forcing speech before readiness causes permanent withdrawal
Calling on them without scaffolding destroys trust
success_indicators: Staying after class to continue conversation
archetypes.session_cross_ref: Mai (Session 21) — classic Silent Observer. Zero-pressure opening. Breakthrough: unprompted self-introduction.
archetypes.transformation_path: MOUSE → slow build → CUB → expert moments → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Overachiever
behavioral_markers: Highest grammar score, lowest spontaneous speech
archetypes.optimal_approach: Reframe mistakes as data. Use 'that's useful — now we know.' Set deliberate imperfection as homework. Celebrate wrong answers showing brave thinking.
archetypes.progression_timeline: 4-6 weeks to unlock spoken risk-taking. Rapid acceleration once 'mistakes are information' frame internalized.
success_indicators: Making jokes using new vocabulary before sure it's correct
archetypes.anti_shame_protocol: NET 'Calibrate not Wrong' rule — every correction reframed as calibration data.
archetypes.transformation_path: MOUSE → reframe errors → CUB → brave speech → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Class Clown
behavioral_markers: Hides behind humor when called on
Strong oral instincts but inconsistent accuracy
archetypes.optimal_approach: Make them comedian-in-residence officially. Assign 'joke of the week' using target vocabulary. Channel performance drive into language games. Humor IS language — validate the intelligence.
archetypes.progression_timeline: Fast. 2-4 weeks once they understand the class needs their energy.
archetypes.transformation_path: CUB → channel humor → comedy precision → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Grammar Nazi
behavioral_markers: Freezes before speaking to verify grammar
Can pass written exams but cannot hold 60-second conversation
archetypes.optimal_approach: Redirect rule obsession — linguistic analysis tasks. Document idiom exceptions. Assign them to teach grammar rule, then prove rules break in real conversation.
archetypes.progression_timeline: 6-10 weeks. Requires specific epiphany: 'Native speakers break rules constantly and still communicate perfectly.'
common_traps: Validating rule-checking as substitute for speaking
success_indicators: First time using idiom incorrectly but keeps going
archetypes.session_cross_ref: Bao (Session 19) — Grammar Nazi flagged. Re-channeled into peer celebration.
archetypes.transformation_path: MOUSE → break rules → CUB → fluent imperfection → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Tiger-In-Waiting
archetypes.optimal_approach: Push them. Hard vocabulary first. Pair with Silent Observers. Assign as class discussion leaders. Tell them directly: 'You are already a Tiger. Prove it.'
success_indicators: Helping other students without being asked
archetypes.session_cross_ref: Trang (Session 19) — Mouse→Cub mid-session. Duc (Session 20) — Tiger Voice solidified, zero prompts.

archetypes.name: The Phone Addict
archetypes.optimal_approach: Pattern interrupt every 7-10 minutes. Use phone as learning tool. Assign TikTok-style English challenges. Phone is not the enemy — boredom is.
archetypes.progression_timeline: If novelty protocol locks in: 4-6 weeks. If not: dropout risk.
common_traps: Confiscating phones without replacing dopamine hit
success_indicators: Voluntarily using phone for English content
archetypes.session_cross_ref: Khoi (Session 18) — TikTok entry point. 4 consecutive minutes explaining algorithm unprompted. First voluntary English sentence.
archetypes.transformation_path: MOUSE → novelty hook → CUB → sustained interest → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Corporate Climber
archetypes.optimal_approach: Tie every lesson to career stakes. Frame English as professional armor. Use real workplace scenarios. 'This idiom will help in your next performance review.'
common_traps: Teaching general English to someone needing professional English
success_indicators: Using English in real work meeting
archetypes.session_cross_ref: Linh (Session 17) — Job interview English. Confidence 3→6/10. First laugh mid-answer. BlueTech Staff — Enterprise tier.
archetypes.transformation_path: CUB → career framing → professional wins → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Reluctant Parent-Pusher
archetypes.optimal_approach: Find hidden interest (football, gaming, music). Never mention parents. Give one small win in first class that is entirely theirs. They must find own reason.
archetypes.progression_timeline: 8-12 weeks if internal motivation unlocked. If not: becomes Dropout Risk.
archetypes.session_cross_ref: Khoi (Session 18) — Internal motivation spark at minute 18 via TikTok. Rule: 'Do NOT mention parents again.'
archetypes.canon_link: Lesson #9 of 10 System-Changing Lessons — 'Reluctant students must be found, not pushed.' Hidden Interest Hunt protocol origin.
archetypes.transformation_path: MOUSE → hidden interest → CUB → internal motivation → TIGER

archetypes.name: The Natural
behavioral_markers: May get bored if pace slow
archetypes.optimal_approach: Accelerate. Bonus vocabulary. Assign as peer tutors. Build meta-linguistic awareness alongside fluency.
archetypes.progression_timeline: Tiger in 6-8 weeks. Must be stretched continuously or plateau and disengage.
common_traps: Holding them back for the class

archetypes.name: The Dropout Risk
archetypes.optimal_approach: Immediate 1-on-1 intervention before week 4. Diagnose root cause. Offer curriculum pivot. Reach out directly. This is a retention event.
archetypes.progression_timeline: Must intervene within 2 weeks of first warning signs.
success_indicators: The 'I didn't know you noticed' realization
archetypes.revenue_link: Direct revenue leak. Parent communication protocol (Tiger Meter + weekly Zalo) = early warning system. VAULT-CHAOS Lesson #4: 'Parent communication is a product.'
archetypes.transformation_path: EXIT ← intervention → MOUSE → restart pathway → TIGER

first_session_signals.signal: Sits in back, no eye contact
Answers first question fluently then stops

confirmation_rules: No archetype locked after one session
Confirm with at least 3 consistent behavioral signals
Students can shift archetypes as they progress
Hybrid archetypes exist (e.g. Overachiever + Grammar Nazi)

tiger_scoring.rule: Applies uniformly across all archetypes. Path is different; standard is identical.

canon_guardrails.principle: Anti-Shame Lexicon — never make students feel stupid
Reluctant students must be found, not pushed
